name: Checkout Progress Indicator
summary: Informational ordered progress composition with complete, current, and upcoming step presentation while routing and navigation remain target-owned.

anatomy.name: step
anatomy.description: Repeated target-owned checkout step with a complete, current, or upcoming status.

anatomy.name: indicator
anatomy.description: Visible step number, completion mark, or equivalent non-color status cue.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Horizontal wide layout that stacks vertically at narrow widths.

states.name: default
states.description: Default progress presentation, including upcoming steps without a status modifier style.

states.name: lastStep
states.description: Final step omits the trailing connector.

behavior.name: stepStatus
behavior.description: Targets supply ordered steps and status values. Only the current step uses aria-current="step"; complete status also has a textual or symbolic cue that does not rely on color alone.

behavior.name: progressSemantics
behavior.description: The root exposes an accessible name and ordered-list semantics. It is informational unless a target separately composes native navigation.

behavior.name: navigationBoundary
behavior.description: This contract does not assign links, route transitions, click behavior, visited-state rules, or checkout-state synchronization to steps.

properties.name: accessibleLabel
properties.description: Accessible name describing the checkout-progress sequence.

properties.name: steps
properties.description: Target-owned ordered step records containing status, visible indicator content, and label text.

accessibility: Render steps as an ordered list with an accessible sequence label.
Apply aria-current="step" only to the current step and expose complete status through text or a meaningful symbol in addition to color.
Keep every step label visible and in source order across horizontal and stacked layouts.
Treat generated connectors as decorative and exclude them from the accessibility tree.
Do not add link or button semantics unless a target explicitly owns checkout navigation and supplies the full interaction contract.

web.notes: Implemented as an informational responsive composition in components/css/pages.css.

shopify.notes: Checkout state and navigation availability require target-native review before adapter mapping.
